major.name: The Hanged Man
major.themes: suspension; letting go; new perspective; waiting

entries.title: Divinatory arts
entries.body: A broad set of interpretive practices using intuition, symbols, tools or perceptions within a clarification-oriented context.

entries.title: Clairvoyance
entries.body: An intuitive practice aimed at perceiving dynamics, tendencies or symbolic information around a situation.

entries.title: Claircognition
entries.body: A form of intuitive perception associated with sudden knowing without apparent conscious reasoning.

entries.title: Clairsentience
entries.body: Intuitive perception experienced through sensations, emotions or bodily impressions.

entries.title: Intuitive mediumship
entries.body: An intuitive practice centered on subtle, symbolic or relational perceptions without claiming absolute proof.

entries.title: Tarot
entries.body: A card system structured around archetypes, images and interpretive sequences.

entries.title: Cartomancy
entries.body: Interpretive card reading using traditional or contemporary decks for clarification.

entries.title: Oracle deck
entries.body: A deck or symbolic tool not necessarily tied to tarot structure.

entries.title: Spread
entries.body: An organized layout of cards or signs used to structure interpretation.

entries.title: Major arcana
entries.body: A tarot card associated with a major archetype or symbolic dynamic.

entries.title: Minor arcana
entries.body: A tarot card associated with concrete situations, nuances or daily dynamics.

entries.title: Symbolism
entries.body: A system of signs, images or correspondences used to develop meaning.

entries.title: Archetype
entries.body: A recurring symbolic form used as an interpretive or representational model.

entries.title: Symbolic interpretation
entries.body: Reading of signs or tools aimed at producing contextualized understanding.

entries.title: Divinatory consultation
entries.body: A structured session around a request, an ethical frame and an intuitive or symbolic interpretation.

entries.title: Client / querent
entries.body: The person requesting a reading or clarification in a consultation context.

entries.title: Free will
entries.body: The principle that the client retains responsibility and decision-making autonomy.

entries.title: Professional responsibility
entries.body: The duty to set boundaries, clarify the framework and prevent abuse.

entries.title: Professional ethics
entries.body: A set of principles framing responsible, transparent and non-manipulative practice.

entries.title: Transparency
entries.body: Clarity about identity, prices, limits, conditions and consultation method.

entries.title: Digital trust
entries.body: Public signals used to assess the reliability of an online professional.

entries.title: Verified review
entries.body: A public review associated with an identifiable collection or verification process.

entries.title: Digital reputation
entries.body: Public image built through reviews, publications, profiles, links, evidence and editorial consistency.

entries.title: Uncertainty
entries.body: A situation where available information does not allow certainty in decision-making.

entries.title: Decision-making
entries.body: Process through which a person evaluates options and chooses a direction.

entries.title: Clarification
entries.body: A process making a situation more readable by distinguishing issues, options and dynamics.

entries.title: Reframing
entries.body: Transforming a confused request into a clearer and more actionable formulation.

entries.title: Open temporality
entries.body: A way of speaking about the future as evolving dynamics rather than closed certainty.

entries.title: Action scenario
entries.body: A cautious projection of possible paths based on an observed dynamic.

entries.title: Consultative dependency
entries.body: A situation where a person consults repeatedly to the point of losing autonomy or perspective.

entries.title: Abusive promise
entries.body: A commercial or predictive claim exploiting hope, fear or vulnerability.

entries.title: Excluded topic
entries.body: A domain refused by the practitioner for ethical or legal reasons.

entries.title: Confidentiality
entries.body: Protection of information shared during a consultation.

entries.title: Anonymization
entries.body: A process aiming to make personal identification impossible within data or examples.

entries.title: Sensitive data
entries.body: Personal information whose use may expose someone to particular risk.

entries.title: Metadata
entries.body: Information describing a resource, document, person, publication or dataset.

entries.title: Schema.org
entries.body: A structured markup vocabulary used to describe entities on the web.

entries.title: ORCID
entries.body: A persistent identifier linking an author or researcher to their works.

entries.title: Working paper
entries.body: A working document shared before formal publication or within an independent framework.

entries.title: Structured data
entries.body: Data organized through explicit columns, categories or relations.

entries.title: Taxonomy
entries.body: An organized classification of terms, categories and conceptual relations.

entries.title: Interpretive bias
entries.body: A tendency to steer interpretation according to expectations, beliefs or emotional context.

entries.title: Projection
entries.body: Attribution of personal content to a symbol, situation or another person.

entries.title: Personal narrative
entries.body: The way a person organizes lived experience into a coherent or meaningful story.

entries.title: Life transition
entries.body: A period of relational, professional, family or personal change.

entries.title: Open question
entries.body: A formulation allowing multiple answers, nuances or paths.

entries.title: Intrusive third-party question
entries.body: A request about the intimate or private life of an absent third party without ethical necessity.

entries.title: Remote consultation
entries.body: A consultation performed by phone, video, chat or another digital channel.

entries.title: Digital divination tool
entries.body: A widget, app or interactive tool offering a spread, calculation or symbolic content.

entries.title: Traceability
entries.body: The ability to link information to its source, date, author or publication context.
